findings.evidence: _ending_spans skips when len(gap) > _MAX_GAP (12), and _lone() does not fire for repeated separator tokens, because each neighbour shares the separator's script. has_link_or_contact: 'Visit refunds-portal ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ com now.' -> True (gap 11), but 'Visit refunds-portal ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ com now.' -> False (gap 13). Also False for: 'refunds-portal 丶 丶 丶 丶 丶 丶 shop', 'refunds-portal ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ ~ cash', 'refunds-portal , , , , , , , com' (while 'refunds-portal, com' -> True), 'refunds-portal ; ; ; ; ; ; ; com', 'refunds-portal -- -- -- -- -- com', 'refunds-portal co m/claim', 'refunds-portal sh op', 'refunds-portal ʘ com/claim', 'refunds-portal xn--p1ai'. End to end (/tmp/uri_review_R11/probe_e2e.py and test_r11_gap.py, 5/5 failing): SY.verify keeps 'Claim your energy rebate refund at refunds-portal ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ ٠ com/claim before the deadline [1]' with its citation, SY.extractive selects it, and build_surface + require_valid accept a surface containing 'refunds-portal'. D16 states 'a name, then anything at all, then a real top-level domain' and joins spelt-out letters; none of these forms is in the accepted residual list.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the fixed gap cap. Bound the work instead (scan back over any non-letter characters to the nearest same-family word, limited to N words). Treat a gap made only of repeated non-word tokens as a separator whatever its length. Join any split of a TLD at spaces (for example 'co m'). Map ACE labels ('xn--...') to the TLD list, or treat them as links.
findings.title: R1-01 link class still open under D16: a separator gap longer than 12 characters (the R10-01 form repeated), a spaced core domain after a long prose gap, 'co m' splits, a Latin dot look-alike letter (U+0298) and a spaced punycode ending pass has_link_or_contact, mask_links, verify(), extractive(), the research surface and the A2UI validator (W1-AC12/AC15)

findings.evidence: httpx.InvalidURL is not an httpx.HTTPError, so the handler '(httpx.HTTPError, OSError, ValueError)' does not catch it. Probe /tmp/uri_review_R11/agent/p3_redirect_crash.py: search hit '☃.com' -> job FAILED INTERNAL_ERROR, sources: 0; user URL with fullwidth digits ('０x5d.184.215.14') -> FAILED INTERNAL_ERROR, sources: 0. Search hits are vetted only by NP.check_url (search.py:68-73).
findings.suggested_fix: Catch httpx.InvalidURL per fetch and record the source as UNREACHABLE or REFUSED. Make check_url refuse hosts that do not survive IDNA and httpx URL parsing. Add a regression test with a bad host among good sources.
findings.title: A host that netpolicy accepts but httpx rejects (InvalidURL) is not caught by SafeFetcher and turns the whole research job into FAILED INTERNAL_ERROR, discarding every good source

findings.evidence: p1_netpolicy.py: 64:ff9b:1:a00:0:100:808:808 ALLOWED (embeds 10.0.0.1 under RFC 6052 with a /48 translator).
